verses.verse:
अन्तः परिधि मानेन मुख रन्ध्रा च्चतुर्गुणे।
परिमाणे षडजस्तारों यदि मध्यो दशमे स्थितः।।१७।।
verses.text: By the measure of the inner circumference, at four times [that measure] from the mouth-hole lies the upper Ṣaḍja, if the middle [Ṣaḍja] lies at the tenth.

commentary.text: The meaning of the above śloka is that the length from the mukharandhra (mouth-hole) to the far end of the pipe, measured by the paridhimāna (measure of the circumference) given before, may be as much as nine times and as little as six times.

Now, whatever the length from the mouth-hole to the end, the sound that comes out when it is blown is named (madhya Sa, middle Sa). Now divide the distance from madhya Sa to the mouth-hole into ten equal parts, and at 4/10 part from the mouth-hole, that is at 6/10 part from madhya Sa, make a mark with a pencil; its name will be tāra Ṡa (upper Sa). After this, between these two Sas, 11 more marks will have to be made in the way given below; then in all 11+2=13 notes will have been placed, whose names will be: Sa, komal Re, Re, komal Ga, Ga, Ma, Ma′, Pa, komal Dha, Dha, komal Ni, Ni, Ṡa.
